test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To rub salt in someone’s wound

options.text: To use salt as a remedy for a painful wound
To make a bad or painful situation worse
To help in bandaging a wound
To make a medicine for wounds

solution: The correct answer is **'To make a bad or painful situation worse'.**
